Bash(# Create a comprehensive analysis
echo ""=== COMPREHENSIVE UNUSED CSS ANALYSIS ==="" > /tmp/analysis.txt
echo """" >> /tmp/analysis.txt

# Get all SCSS files
find src/app -name ""*.scss"" -type f | while read scss_file; do
    echo ""Processing: $scss_file"" >> /tmp/analysis.txt
    
    # Skip if it''s not a component file (has no corresponding .html/.ts)
    base_path=$(echo ""$scss_file"" | sed ''s/\.scss$//'')
    html_file=""$base_path.html""
    ts_file=""$base_path.ts""
    
    if [ ! -f ""$html_file"" ] && [ ! -f ""$ts_file"" ]; then
        echo ""  SKIP: No corresponding HTML/TS files"" >> /tmp/analysis.txt
        echo """" >> /tmp/analysis.txt
        continue
    fi
    
    # Extract classes from SCSS
    classes=$(rg -o ''\.([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)\s*\{'' ""$scss_file"" 2>/dev/null | sed ''s/^\.//; s/\s*{$//'')
    
    if [ -z ""$classes"" ]; then
        echo ""  NO CLASSES FOUND"" >> /tmp/analysis.txt
        echo """" >> /tmp/analysis.txt
        continue
    fi
    
    echo ""  Classes found: $(echo $classes | wc -w)"" >> /tmp/analysis.txt
    
    unused_classes=""""
    for class in $classes; do
        found=false
        
        # Check in HTML file
        if [ -f ""$html_file"" ]; then
            if rg -q ""class=\""[^\""]*\\b$class\\b[^\""]*\"""" ""$html_file"" 2>/dev/null || \
               rg -q ""\\[class\\]=\""[^\""]*\\b$class\\b[^\""]*\"""" ""$html_file"" 2>/dev/null || \
               rg -q ""\\[ngClass\\]=\""[^\""]*\\b$class\\b[^\""]*\"""" ""$html_file"" 2>/dev/null || \
               rg -q ""''$class''"" ""$html_file"" 2>/dev/null; then
                found=true
            fi
        fi
        
        # Check in TS file
        if [ -f ""$ts_file"" ] && [ ""$found"" = false ]; then
            if rg -q ""''$class''"" ""$ts_file"" 2>/dev/null || \
               rg -q ""\""$class\"""" ""$ts_file"" 2>/dev/null; then
                found=true
            fi
        fi
        
        if [ ""$found"" = false ]; then
            unused_classes=""$unused_classes $class""
        fi
    done
    
    if [ -n ""$unused_classes"" ]; then
        echo ""  UNUSED:$unused_classes"" >> /tmp/analysis.txt
    else
        echo ""  ALL CLASSES USED"" >> /tmp/analysis.txt
    fi
    
    echo """" >> /tmp/analysis.txt
done

# Display the analysis
cat /tmp/analysis.txt)
